properties.name: One line: `decomposition_coverage` added to the not-a-tool term list, alphabetically beside `design_without_intent` and `missing_intermediate_level`, which are gap_source values too. The lint reads backticked identifiers in served skills and asks whether each names a tool; a new gap_source appearing in detect-and-ask's expectation list is a field term, not a tool, and the lint's own failure message names this list as the fix. NO RULE CHANGED — no check added, removed or weakened, and the trap this list can become (adding a REAL tool to it, which teaches you to lie to the gate) is not triggered here: nothing named decomposition_coverage is or ever was a served tool.
